description: This Java class implements the <call-object-method> element for a mini-language, enabling dynamic method invocation on objects within the OFBiz framework. It handles parsing XML configuration, executing method calls, and providing string representations.

classes.name: CallObjectMethod
classes.description: Represents a mini-language element that calls a method on an object dynamically, with support for parameters and return value handling.

classes.name: CallObjectMethodFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CallObjectMethod from XML elements.

methods.name: CallObjectMethod
methods.description: Constructor that parses XML element to initialize method call details, including method name, target object, parameters, and return field.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the method call on the target object retrieved from the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the call-object-method element with its attributes.
